Body.Content:
Updated October 5, 2026: We have updated the content. Thank you for your patience. 

What and Why:

We are introducing support for inserting Agents and Skills directly into prompts via the Context IQ (CIQ) menu which users can access by selecting "Add content" after opening the Plus (+) menu. Users will be able to access available Agents and Skills from the CIQ Agents and Skills tab after selecting "Add content" or by referencing them by typing / or @ while composing prompts. Users will be able to access available Agents and Skills from the CIQ Agents and Skills tab and quickly reference them by typing / or @ while composing prompts. This improvement helps users discover and use specialized capabilities more efficiently, improving productivity by making context-specific AI assistance easier to access within existing workflows.

Screenshot - Agents & skills tab in CIQ menu when user selects "Add content" from the Plus (+) menu.

Screenshot - Agents & skills tab when user types "/" or "@" in the prompt box.

Rollout Schedule:

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout begins in mid-September 2026.
  • Expected completion: Late September 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • Users who have access to CIQ and available Agents and Skills within their organization.

Platforms/Services:

  • CIQ
  • Copilot experiences that support Agents and Skills integration

What will happen:

  • Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills directly into prompts using @ and /.
  • Agents and Skills will be discoverable from the CIQ Agents and Skills tab.
  • Users can quickly access specialized capabilities without navigating away from their current experience.
  • The change is available by default where Agents and Skills are supported.
  • No changes to existing user workflows are required; this enhancement provides an additional way to invoke available capabilities.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No action is required.

You may want to:

  • Inform users about the new Agents and Skills discovery experience.
  • Update internal training or adoption materials if your organization documents CIQ workflows.
  • Review any organizational guidance related to approved Agents and Skills usage.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
